# Public trust demo fixture

Generated 2026-09-26. 1,000 synthetic AI-routing decision records, log origin
`calybris.tech/demo-log`. FreeTSA token covers the log-signed note, nonce is
stored separately. Certificates and verifying keys are public; no secret keys.

The witness is operated by the maintainer, not an independent organisation.
The CLI regression checks configured pins and does not certify that independence.
OTS was Pending at capture. Do not represent this as confirmed Bitcoin evidence.
